description: This file provides functions and constants for managing SELinux labels and modes, including setting labels on files, processes, sockets, and keys, as well as querying SELinux status and modes.

methods.name: SetDisabled
methods.description: Disables SELinux support for the package.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether SELinux is currently enabled.

methods.name: ClassIndex
methods.description: Returns the int index for an object class in the loaded policy, or -1 and an error.

methods.name: SetFileLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for a specified path, following symlinks.

methods.name: LsetFileLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for a specified path, not following symlinks.

methods.name: FileLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the SELinux label for a specified path, following symlinks.

methods.name: LfileLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the SELinux label for a specified path, not following symlinks.

methods.name: SetFSCreateLabel
methods.description: Sets the label to be used for all file system objects created by the current task.

methods.name: FSCreateLabel
methods.description: Returns the default label the kernel is using for file system objects created by the current task.

methods.name: CurrentLabel
methods.description: Returns the SELinux label of the current process thread.

methods.name: PidLabel
methods.description: Returns the SELinux label of the specified pid.

methods.name: ExecLabel
methods.description: Returns the SELinux label that the kernel will use for programs executed by the current process thread.

methods.name: CanonicalizeContext
methods.description: Converts a context string into its canonical form.

methods.name: ComputeCreateContext
methods.description: Requests the type transition from source to target for a class from the kernel.

methods.name: CalculateGlbLub
methods.description: Computes the greatest lower bound and least upper bound of source and target ranges.

methods.name: SetExecLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for programs that are executed by the current process thread.

methods.name: SetTaskLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for the current thread.

methods.name: SetSocketLabel
methods.description: Assigns a label to the next socket created by the process.

methods.name: SocketLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the current socket label setting.

methods.name: PeerLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the client on the other side of a socket.

methods.name: SetKeyLabel
methods.description: Assigns a label to the next kernel keyring created.

methods.name: KeyLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the current kernel keyring label setting.

methods.name: Context.Get
methods.description: Returns the Context as a string.

methods.name: NewContext
methods.description: Creates a new Context struct from a label.

methods.name: ClearLabels
methods.description: Clears all reserved labels.

methods.name: ReserveLabel
methods.description: Reserves the MLS/MCS level component of a label.

methods.name: MLSEnabled
methods.description: Checks if MLS is enabled.

methods.name: EnforceMode
methods.description: Returns the current SELinux mode: Enforcing, Permissive, or Disabled.

methods.name: SetEnforceMode
methods.description: Sets the current SELinux mode: Enforcing or Permissive.

methods.name: DefaultEnforceMode
methods.description: Returns the system's default SELinux mode at boot.

methods.name: ReleaseLabel
methods.description: Un-reserves the MLS/MCS Level field of a label.

methods.name: ROFileLabel
methods.description: Returns the specified SELinux readonly file label.

methods.name: KVMContainerLabels
methods.description: Returns default process and mount labels for KVM containers.

methods.name: InitContainerLabels
methods.description: Returns default process and file labels for containers with init systems.

methods.name: ContainerLabels
methods.description: Returns allocated process and file labels for container labeling.

methods.name: SecurityCheckContext
methods.description: Validates that the SELinux label is understood by the kernel.

methods.name: CopyLevel
methods.description: Returns a label with the MLS/MCS level from src label replaced on the dest label.

methods.name: Chcon
methods.description: Changes the SELinux label of a file object, optionally recursively.

methods.name: DupSecOpt
methods.description: Returns security options for setting SELinux Type and Level for container processes.

methods.name: DisableSecOpt
methods.description: Returns a security option to disable SELinux labeling support for container processes.

methods.name: GetDefaultContextWithLevel
methods.description: Gets a context for a specified SELinux user identity reachable from a source context.

methods.name: PrivContainerMountLabel
methods.description: Returns mount label for privileged containers.
